subject: Strange error about transparency with geom_smooth

messages.author: 3c9c3a677d88c607
messages.subject: Strange error about transparency with geom_smooth
parts:
Dear List,

I get a strange error with geom_smooth that seems to be related to the transparency:


> test <- data.frame(xx=rnorm(100),yyy=rnorm(100))
> pl <- qplot(xx,yyy, data=test, geom="smooth")
> pl

Warning message:
In grid.Call.graphics("L_polygon", x$x, x$y, list(as.integer(seq_along(x$x)))) :
  semi-transparency is not supported on this device: reported only once per page

The middle line of the smoother is drawn, but not the semi-transparent shade.


> sessionInfo()
R version 2.10.0 (2009-10-26)
x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

locale:
[1] C

attached base packages:
[1] grid      stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods
[8] base

other attached packages:
[1] ggplot2_0.8.5 digest_0.4.2  reshape_0.8.3 plyr_0.1.9    proto_0.3-8

I am running OpenSuSe 11.1 with KDE 4.3.5. Could this be in any way related to the Compositing/Desktop Effects in KDE 4?

Thanks for your help,

Sebastian

messages.author: 41ed89aa70b5d27c
messages.subject: Re: Strange error about transparency with geom_smooth
parts:
Not all devices support transparency (also called alpha blending).
You are clearly using one of those. The specifics depends on the
device and also perhaps what image library R is linked to. See the
section "Color specification" in ?par and check out the help page for
the device you are using, for example ?pdf. If you are using X11
(plotting on screen) you need to use the Cairo backend, not Xlib (see
?x11). Cairo may be missing from your system as it seems that you are
using a 64bit version under linux. In that case you need to get your
sysadmin to install cairo and cairo-devel and to re-compile R.
Details are highly dependent on your system setup.

Kasper
